title: Player immobilized on Map3 stairs due to velocity zeroing (stair_stick)
explanation: Between frames 806 and 1089, the player is trapped at stair coordinates [68, 7] (position x≈5426-5458, y≈559) with velocity forced to zero despite directional movement inputs. Traced to Player.gd:L150-L167, which clamps velocity to zero on Map3 within a hardcoded bounding box until multiple leftward inputs are registered. This violates the kinematic contract that unobstructed geometry must permit player movement.
